requirements.description: Empty, long, block-boundary and malformed hash inputs
Valid, altered-message, altered-key and altered-signature verification
Profile-specific acceptance/rejection of noncanonical scalars, low-order points and malformed sizes
Cardano extended Ed25519 exact signing and public key vectors
BIP39 entropy and mnemonic known answers
Malformed word counts, word lists, checksums and entropy sizes
Icarus root generation with and without second factor
Shelley CIP-1852 root and account key derivation known answers
Byron legacy root generation exact pinned Haskell vectors
Byron derivation-path payload encryption, decryption and malformed CBOR
Ledger hardware-wallet root derivation known answers
Trezor hardware-wallet root derivation known answers
Soft/hardened index boundaries, all roles and account paths
Public child equals public extraction of private child for soft paths
Pinned wallet passphrase hashing, checking and wrong-password rejection
Legacy scrypt checking and migration semantics
V1/V2 root-key encryption, authentication and passphrase change through domain adapter
Base, enterprise, pointer and reward address vectors
Byron random/Icarus/HD payload, CRC and network attributes
Shared-wallet script address construction and cosigner templates
Network tags, protocol magic and cross-network rejection
Bech32/base58 roundtrip, checksum, length and noncanonical rejection
Policy IDs, key hashes, asset fingerprints and metadata signatures
Canonical CBOR roundtrips and malformed/trailing/duplicate-key rejection across eras
Exact transaction body hashes and IDs
VKey/bootstrap/script witness construction, validation and merging
Signed constructed transaction accepted and confirmed by a real node
Confirmed output pays the requested address and exact asset quantities
Fee coefficients, witness size, script execution, rounding and size boundaries
Minimum ADA for outputs and native assets under pinned protocol parameters
TTL, validity lower bound, slot conversion and expiry rejection
Metadata CBOR, size limits, labels and text/byte encodings
Native token mint/burn quantities, witnesses and supply conservation
Eligibility, collateral percentage, total collateral and return
Registration, delegation, deposits, retirement and reward withdrawal
Vote delegation, DRep operations and era-specific certificates
Ledger rejects corrupted or missing witnesses
Conflicting input submissions cannot both confirm
Selected ADA equals requested outputs plus fee and change
Every native asset conserved through selection and change
Input identifiers unique and drawn only from available eligible UTxOs
Change meets minimum ADA and does not discard assets
Input count and transaction size limits
Insufficient ADA, asset, fee and collateral failures
Pinned Haskell algorithm outputs with explicit random seeds and strategy
Checked arithmetic at coin and token bounds
Multiple outputs, asset bundles, split change and dust
Sender and recipient confirmed balances conserve payment and fee
UTxO snapshots, statistics and balance agree with chain history
Sequential, random and shared discovery, gap limits, internal/external roles
Restore from genesis/checkpoint matches uninterrupted history
Rollback restores spent inputs, balance, history and pending state
Persist/restart preserves wallet identity, addresses, keys and pending transactions
Pending, expiry, retry and node disconnect/reconnect behavior
Concurrent selection/signing/submission cannot reserve or spend inputs inconsistently
Incomplete, active, partially signed and fully signed shared-wallet workflows
Byron random and Icarus restore, spend and migrate through public API
Public-key wallets derive correct addresses and reject unavailable signing
Time/status/order filters, pagination and binary metadata representation
Pool metadata, ranking, retirement and maintenance API state
Governance query and voting state consistent with the chain
Wrong signing passphrase fails without state change
Observe real node tip height advance during this run
Same payment ID confirmed in sender and recipient histories
Fees, min-UTxO and slotting use actual node parameters
Pre/post hard-fork restoration, transaction and certificate boundaries
Malformed JSON, methods, media types, headers, unknown paths and invalid parameters
Status/error code/message precedence agrees with the pinned Haskell wallet
CIP-1854 shared wallet root and account derivation
Identical selection results for repeated requests with the same explicit seed
Trusted independent node query finds the submitted transaction recipient output with its exact address and ADA amount
Every committed HTTP scenario case also passes against a distinct independent reference, comparing stable fields, statuses, media types and error bodies
Wallet latest header hash, slot and height match an independently observed recent node tip
Exact cardano-crypto 1.3.0 extended-verification semantics, including canonical/tampered signatures, chain code, identity points, S+L and malformed lengths
